scientific_question: Across the frozen 2/3/4/6-layer active-lower-zone ladder, which representation first preserves groundwater-exchange behavior under a prescribed zero-pressure lower boundary, and how does that differ from full-profile fidelity?

predecessors.A1: L3 minimum bounded B01 predictive-state candidate; L4/L6 added no demonstrated future-response state information in the A1 common cohort.
predecessors.A2_A2B: Storage-only closure alternatives did not robustly repair L3 long-interface error.
predecessors.A3: One additional global first moment did not have broad support; same-dimension explicit local L4 resolution was more faithful.
predecessors.BC1: Fixed-domain prescribed-head CURRENT_LAYER_FACE closure qualified with resolution dependence.
predecessors.C4R: Blind fixed-water-table validation established comparator-relative frontiers on R3+ and supplies immutable blind Reference/comparator evidence.

physical_domain.bottom_boundary: zero pressure head at fixed 160 cm boundary

blind_reference_reuse.blind_status: Histories were frozen before the C4R Reference trajectories existed. B1 reuses them without changing history, forcing, material or response metrics.

layer_ladder.role: aggressive two-layer challenge absent from C4R LARE ladder

model.internal_closure: standard source-anchored adjacent-layer LARE Taylor/Darcy closure

comparators.Reference_R16: blind current-canonical 16 x 10 cm accepted-trajectory Reference from C4R
comparators.CoRichards_R2: blind C4R integrated-mass 2 x 80 cm Richards comparator
comparators.rule: Comparator metrics are recovered from the immutable C4R artifact and must reproduce its persisted C4R result before B1 interpretation.

relative_frontiers.crosses_R2_GW: candidate is no worse than C4R R2 on every GW component
relative_frontiers.crosses_FMC_GW: candidate is no worse than C4R FMC on every GW component
relative_frontiers.crosses_R2_PROFILE: candidate crosses R2_GW and is no worse on mapped profile RMSE
relative_frontiers.crosses_FMC_PROFILE: candidate crosses FMC_GW and is no worse on mapped profile RMSE
relative_frontiers.minimum_rule: For each purpose/comparator report the smallest dimension in the frozen L2/L3/L4/L6 ladder that crosses componentwise.
relative_frontiers.no_crossing_rule: Report NOT_REACHED_WITHIN_L2_L3_L4_L6, never extrapolate a dimension.

hypotheses.H1: L2 and L3 will not cross the blind groundwater comparator frontiers.
hypotheses.H2: L4 will be the first member to cross both R2_GW and FMC_GW, replicating C4R's dimension-4 groundwater frontier after adding the previously absent L2 challenge.
hypotheses.H3: L6 will materially reduce profile error relative to L4 but need not cross the stricter FMC_PROFILE frontier.
hypotheses.H4: If L4 and L6 preserve the same qualitative flux-sign pattern while L6 mainly improves continuous errors, the remaining difference is closure/discretization convergence rather than newly demonstrated A1 state information.

decision_logic.B1_DIMENSION4_GW_FRONTIER_REPLICATED: All integrity gates pass and the minimum dimensions for R2_GW and FMC_GW are both 4.
decision_logic.B1_LOWER_DIMENSION_GW_FRONTIER: All integrity gates pass and either groundwater frontier is first crossed below dimension 4.
decision_logic.B1_HIGHER_DIMENSION_REQUIRED_FOR_GW_FRON: All integrity gates pass and either groundwater frontier is first crossed only at dimension 6 or is not reached within the ladder.
decision_logic.B1_EXECUTION_OR_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED: Any immutable-evidence reproduction, source-freeze, mass, physical-domain or deterministic execution gate fails.

interpretation_boundaries: Comparator-relative frontier is not application acceptance.
GW and PROFILE frontiers remain separate.
B1 tests a fixed zero-pressure lower boundary, not moving-water-table geometry and not production groundwater coupling.
A1 state-information sufficiency and B1 closure-propagation fidelity answer different questions.
No performance or speed claim is authorized.
next_if_dimension4_gw_frontier: Preregister B2 prospective longer-horizon and reversal-focused fixed-head validation with L3/L4/L6 frozen before any performance measurement.
next_if_higher_dimension: Do not tune L4 post hoc; retain L6 or return to representation/closure research according to the component failure pattern.
